workflowSteps.label: Intake document
workflowSteps.description: Receive a driver, carrier, or load document into the BOF Vault intake queue.

workflowSteps.label: Classify document type
workflowSteps.description: Identify whether the file is a CDL, medical card, insurance certificate, rate confirmation, POD, or another controlled document.

workflowSteps.label: Assign to person/entity
workflowSteps.description: Match the document to the right driver, carrier, load, or settlement record before it affects readiness.

workflowSteps.label: Extract effective date
workflowSteps.description: Record the effective date when the document creates coverage, qualification, or operational authority.

workflowSteps.label: Extract expiration date
workflowSteps.description: Record the expiration date or mark the document as non-expiring when appropriate.

workflowSteps.label: Determine primary vs secondary
workflowSteps.description: Separate controlling readiness documents from supporting evidence and settlement backup.

workflowSteps.label: Check required fields
workflowSteps.description: Compare the document against required field rules for its type.

workflowSteps.label: Identify verification source
workflowSteps.description: Assign the correct verification source, such as a licensing agency, FMCSA-style verifier, insurer, customer, carrier, or internal reviewer.

workflowSteps.label: Assign compliance status
workflowSteps.description: Mark the document as ready, at risk, blocked, or needing review.

workflowSteps.label: Route exceptions to human review
workflowSteps.description: Send missing fields, expired records, wrong-driver matches, and low-confidence documents to the right BOF reviewer.

workflowSteps.label: Update driver readiness
workflowSteps.description: Update driver, carrier, load, settlement, or readiness status after review.
